result.title: Efficient Online Submodular Maximization with Bandit Feedback
result.summary: We study online monotone submodular maximization under a cardinality constraint with bandit feedback. On each round, the learner selects at most $k$ elements from a ground set of size $n$ and observes only the value of the selected set. We develop an efficient algorithm achieving $O\!\left(k\sqrt{nT\log(n/k)}\right)$ expected $(1-1/e)$-regret over $T$ rounds. To our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm with $\sqrt{T}$ dependence on the horizon for arbitrary monotone submodular functions in the bandit setting. Our approach uses randomized sampling and a carefully constructed potential to reduce online submodular maximization to online linear optimization over the probability simplex.

AI.brief_summary: 研究带 bandit 反馈的在线单调子模最大化（基数约束），提出多项式时间算法，通过随机采样与构造势函数把问题归约为概率单纯形上的在线线性优化，取得 O(k√(nT log(n/k))) 的期望 (1−1/e)-regret。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只观测所选集合整体价值」的反馈设定与子模集合选择，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据子集筛选及查询受限下的获取策略提供算法工具，但距离主线较远，需核查可迁移性。
